parameters.content:
## Dragon v3 — idempotent, authorized, non-destructive labels

- Sender must be in the allowlist (currently: repo owner only).
- opened/labeled/reopened matrix enforced in code; every other action and every non-matching label is rejected and logged.
- Initial opened+labeled events share commandVersion `initial`; a deliberate clean reopen uses GitHub `updated_at` as a new retry cycle.
- Lock is acquired atomically through Supabase with an explicit composite `on_conflict` target.
- Status labels are changed individually, so unrelated labels are preserved.
- Every received event is logged before processing.
- Role: Executive Intake & Drafting Assistant. No execution tools. Every posted comment carries a fixed disclaimer.
- Local automated acceptance tests pass; live n8n/Supabase acceptance is still mandatory before activation.

DO NOT ACTIVATE until the live acceptance matrix is complete.
